items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Like, uh, Pichon would do his own, uh, his own numbers.

ctx.x: Somebody once told me that Steve Lewis was sort of the brains of the Piron band, as if he was the best musician there, helped arrange and maybe wrote a lot of those pieces.

Well, I'll tell you, Steve composed a lot of numbers of his own. He had special songs that he used to sing and the people went for his singing. He had a nice voice. On the order of Fats. What, Fat Pichon? Like, uh, Pichon would do his own, uh, his own numbers. Uh, Steve had his own numbers to do like that. And, uh, they would buck and they would give concerts. That's what made, uh, Steve Lewis so famous. Cause he had certain numbers that the band wouldn't play with him at all. He just would feature himself on the…
Do you remember some of those special numbers that he played?
